name: vega: a distribution uses a native density or bin transform
description: The expressive end. A smooth distribution needs a density transform whose output fields the file does not contain, so this exercises the produced-field allowance in the tool's name check: a spec encoding `density` and `value` must be accepted rather than refused as unknown columns.
inputs: Show the distribution of Glucose from the dataset in this history as a smooth density curve.

*.why: plotly_histogram bins rather than smooths; a smooth curve needs a density computed into a dataset first and then a Galaxy visualization plugin saved or shown through save_visualization or show_visualization, which no agent run has shown.
